class.name: LRTVolume3D
class.description:
Owns one [LRTVolume] and everything around it: it reads inputs from the same [World3D], prepares shared geometry SDFs and per-instance material fields on worker threads, captures native per-light unit irradiance into persistent GPU fields, continuously blends each completed coherent snapshot into injection, propagates the 26-neighbor RGB SH4 transport and draws the migrated diffuse result on the scene's own standard materials. Light irradiance textures stay on the GPU. Geometry material captures are read back asynchronously and decoded on worker threads. Light color, energy, indirect energy, temperature and negative sign reweight the GPU fields without waiting for another raster capture.
For LRT, [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_DISABLED] receives indirect light without contributing to the local field. Both [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_STATIC] and [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_DYNAMIC] contribute geometry, diffuse color and emission. Moving a Dynamic mesh updates affected Trunks at its old and new positions, reusing unchanged Trunks and the shared mesh SDF. These contribution rules are specific to LRT. Geometry contribution currently supports [MeshInstance3D], [MultiMeshInstance3D], mesh-based [CPUParticles3D] and [GPUParticles3D], [GridMap] render meshes, and the final mesh of a CSG root. Visible GridMaps contribute their current cell instances or baked meshes without generating additional geometry. MultiMesh and CPU particle instances share the base mesh SDF; their native instance buffers and material voxels are captured asynchronously. GPU particles use their native draw passes and current render buffers, including local or world coordinates and weighted particle trails. Invisible instances and inactive particles do not contribute. CSG Boolean operands are not collected separately. Other native geometry can receive LRT through Forward+ but does not yet contribute geometry. Alpha Scissor, Alpha Hash, shader [code]discard[/code], and vertex deformation use the rendered surface for geometry capture. Their precision follows the instance SDF resolution. Set [member GeometryInstance3D.custom_aabb] or [member GeometryInstance3D.extra_cull_margin] to cover vertices displaced outside the mesh bounds. Fully discarded surfaces do not occlude or emit. Shaders using [code]TIME[/code] capture the current renderer time and update at the Volume's dynamic update interval; these snapshots do not use persistent Volume caches. Billboards, standard material Height Mapping (including Deep Parallax), shaders reading camera matrices, and fragment shaders using view-space [code]VERTEX[/code], [code]NORMAL[/code], [code]TANGENT[/code], [code]BINORMAL[/code], or [code]LIGHT_VERTEX[/code] use the active Camera3D of the Volume's Viewport (the last-used 3D editor viewport when editing). Camera changes invalidate their captures. For single meshes, capture and Volume intersection bounds follow standard material Billboard, Keep Scale, Fixed Size and Grow settings, including Overlay and Next Pass transformations. Instanced draws use their aggregate visibility bounds; these must cover all rendered instances and material deformation. Ordinary alpha-blended, additive, refractive, proximity-faded, and screen-buffer-dependent passes receive LRT but do not contribute occlusion, diffuse color, or emission. Alpha Depth Pre-Pass contributes only fragments with alpha at least 0.99, matching the native opaque prepass. These rules apply per pass: a transparent Overlay or Next Pass does not remove an opaque pass from capture. Receive-only geometry is identified in the Inspector. Other shaders depending on screen-space fragment coordinates or stereo view inputs cannot contribute; the instance status reports the unsupported material.
Indirect light is displayed with a frame-rate-independent temporal response controlled by [member ProjectSettings.rendering/global_illumination/lrt/propagation/display_response_time]. Presentation continues between geometry publications and on frames without propagation work. Occupied probes reject history immediately; direct sky and geometry connectivity are not temporally blended. This smooths changes after data becomes available but does not remove background build latency. The probe grid and history live in this node's local space, so a rigidly moving or rotating parent carries them without rebuilding. Scaling this volume or one of its parents is rejected, while collected mesh instances may use arbitrary non-uniform scale. The editor draws the volume box with the same gizmo as a ReflectionProbe. Six face handles resize it, while a seventh handle edits the shared six-face blend distance.
In the editor, a new volume remains [code]Not Built[/code] until [b]Rebuild LRT[/b] is pressed in the selected-node 3D toolbar. Editing [member size] or [member probe_spacing] marks the previous result [code]Out of Date[/code] without discarding it; runtime and exports always build the latest configuration automatically. Valid local-field data is cached under [code].godot/lrt[/code] and restored by content fingerprint. LRT diagnostics are viewport-owned modes under [b]View > Display Advanced... > LRT[/b], alongside VoxelGI and Dynamic GI diagnostics.
When [member external_gi_enabled] is enabled, a compatible renderer diffuse GI provider can supply one-way RGB SH2 boundary conditions. LRT works independently when no provider is available and never writes radiance back into the provider. The provider must supply radiance excluding sky, because LRT injects the authored sky independently. [member blend_distance] is independent: without external GI the boundary transitions to zero indirect light.

method.name: prepare_mesh_sdf
method.description: Prepares the geometry-only SDF dependency without changing the mesh or scene. A resolution of zero uses the project default. Returns [code]ok[/code], the content [code]signature[/code], cache and packed paths, and whether existing data was loaded. Failures return an [code]error[/code]. Material changes do not change this signature. Exported projects write generated data to [code]user://lrt_cache[/code].

method.name: get_build_stats
method.description: Probe, receiver and timing counters of the last applied bake. [code]queue_wait_ms[/code] measures the wait from prepared geometry inputs to worker entry, including asynchronous capture readback and worker scheduling. [code]capture_decode_ms[/code] measures material and instance capture decoding on the worker; it is included in [code]worker_total_ms[/code], not in queue wait.

method.name: get_preparation_status
method.description: Returns preparation state and generation together with scheduler work, queue age, application latency, native-capture pages, GPU resolves, field blending and propagation counters. In [code]frame_cpu_breakdown[/code], [code]geometry_input_ms[/code] measures synchronous geometry preparation and capture submission during the latest poll, including failed attempts. [code]geometry_update_ms[/code] includes collection, signatures, cache lookup, preparation and capture submission; it overlaps the individual geometry timings and must not be added to them. First admission rotates between eligible Volumes each frame. [code]geometry_budget_overrun_ms[/code] reports how far preparation exceeded the current frame budget; cold-start costs do not create debt in later frames. [code]geometry_update_count[/code] and [code]geometry_budget_deferred_frames[/code] count admitted and deferred automatic updates. The global [code]rendering/global_illumination/lrt/dynamic_objects/cpu_budget_ms[/code] setting defaults to 0.5 ms. A complete Volume snapshot is indivisible and may exceed the budget; remaining preparation stops for that frame. This budget excludes explicit rebuild input inspection, scene save/export, lighting, background baking and GPU execution. The propagation GPU budget remains separate. [code]particle_buffer_async_readbacks[/code], [code]particle_buffer_async_readback_reuses[/code] and [code]particle_buffer_async_readback_bytes[/code] count submitted particle buffer reads, shared requests and requested bytes for this Volume. Counters accumulate when material-capture callbacks arrive, including superseded captures, and reset with the node. Reused requests do not add submitted bytes; sum across Volumes to measure shared work. These counters exclude material textures and synchronous export captures.

method.name: get_cancelled_builds
method.description: Number of background bakes that were superseded and thrown away.

method.name: get_dropped_builds
method.description: Number of finished bakes that were discarded because a newer one already existed.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Last configuration or build error, or an empty string.

method.name: get_geometry_builds
method.description: Number of local fields this node has built and applied.

method.name: get_instance_sdf_status
method.description: Returns the instance's contribution/build state from the latest collection. Unsupported contributing materials return [code]Failed[/code]. Use [method get_instance_sdf_message] for the material error or contribution details.

method.name: get_instance_sdf_message
method.description: Returns the Inspector's explanation of contributing and receive-only passes, camera dependencies, required capture bounds, or unsupported material errors. Counts include each surface's Overlay and Next Pass draws. The report describes the latest collection by this Volume.

method.name: get_instance_sdf_resolution
method.description: Returns the instance's [code]lrt_sdf_resolution[/code] metadata override, or [code]0[/code] when it inherits the volume or project default.

method.name: get_solver
method.description: The underlying solver, for diagnostics and parity checks.

method.name: get_sky_radiance
method.description: Returns the Godot environment radiance projected into three RGB SH2 vectors in this Volume's current local frame. This is diagnostic output; production sky transport uses exact HDR samples at the 384 directions of an 8x8-per-face cubemap quadrature.

method.name: get_volume_warnings
method.description: Configuration warnings of this volume, including transform restrictions and ambiguous external Dynamic GI sky ownership.

method.name: is_building
method.description: Whether a bake is queued, a background bake is running, or a local-field upload is pending. Queued work may wait for the CPU preparation budget or for rebuild suppression to end.

method.name: poll
method.description: Runs one frame of the node's scheduler immediately: input refresh, completed worker/upload work, light-capture progress and budgeted propagation. Scripts and test tools use it to drive the volume without waiting for process frames.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Collects the scene inputs for immediate inspection and queues a forced background bake. Capture submission starts during a later poll when the CPU preparation budget permits, after collecting fresh inputs.

method.name: reset_field
method.description: Clears radiance, visibility and the iteration history, and stays paused.

method.name: set_rebuild_suppressed
method.description: Holds rebuilds while an editor drag resizes the volume; releasing it bakes once for the final state.

method.name: set_instance_sdf_resolution
method.description: Stores a persistent [code]lrt_sdf_resolution[/code] metadata override on [param instance] and requests a rebuild. A value at or below zero removes the override and restores inheritance.

method.name: step
method.description: Runs the given number of propagation rounds and stays paused.

method.name: step_update
method.description: Runs one complete scheduler quantum and leaves propagation paused. The selected-Volume [b]LRT Debug[/b] menu exposes this operation without serializing debug state.

members.member: Whether the surface reconstruction weights the 27 candidate probes with the prototype's quadratic B-spline (enabled) or takes the nearest valid probe (disabled, for diagnosis).

Controls overlap ordering. Higher priorities cover lower ones; equal priorities use scene-tree order, with later nodes covering earlier nodes. Boundary transitions reveal the lower Volume or the native environment. Volumes solve independently and do not exchange radiance.

Distance from each outer face over which final diffuse indirect lighting transitions from LRT to external Dynamic GI, or to zero indirect light when Dynamic GI is unavailable. Zero disables boundary blending.
Legacy script-only comparison property. Production boundary blending is enabled whenever [member blend_distance] is greater than zero.
Whether the volume also builds and draws while the scene is open in the editor.
Probe spacing in metres. Smaller values increase spatial detail and memory use.
Size of the probe region in metres, centred on the node's position.
[code]Color SDF[/code] (prototype default) or the prototype's [code]Analytic boxes[/code] path, which only accepts axis-aligned boxes.
Maximum propagation rounds submitted per frame while unpaused. The scheduler may submit fewer to respect the project propagation budget. Zero stops automatic propagation.
Enables optional boundary input from a compatible diffuse GI provider. This does not enable or configure another GI system.

Legacy script-only comparison control. Production geometry SDF precision is selected by the MeshInstance3D override, then [code]rendering/global_illumination/lrt/sdf/default_resolution[/code]. The Volume never overrides object SDF precision.
Whether the transferred radiance is reflected again each round (the prototype's bounce term).
Pauses automatic propagation. Input collection, geometry builds and light captures continue. Use [method step] to advance propagation.

Propagation neighbor selection. [code]Full 26[/code] is the production default. [code]Four Point Dithered[/code] is an explicitly experimental three-seed spatial dither retained for comparison after failing the P2 steady-state quality gate.
[code]SH triple product[/code] (prototype default) or the [code]26-direction mask[/code] occlusion path.

constants.constant: Per-asset Color SDF, the prototype's default path.
The prototype's analytic axis-aligned box path, used for box-fixture comparison.
Experimental four-point spatial dither with three temporal seeds.
